external_evidence: The reporter's failure is intermittent (iterations 4 to 26 of a create/delete loop) and disappears when Bitdefender Incident Sensor is disabled, across multiple 200-iteration runs. The failing call is EndUpdateResourceW on a freshly written uv-trampoline exe, returning ERROR_OPEN_FAILED (110). That pattern is consistent with the security agent holding a file handle during the commit. The defect sits in the AV product's file interaction, and the reporter's CI VM shows the same behaviour.

possible_duplicates.reason: Same error text, 'Failed to update Windows PE resources' on uv-trampoline-*.exe, during venv/seed-package creation on Windows. It is closed as a duplicate of an issue that the search did not surface, so the canonical tracker is not identified here. Its reporter gave no trigger or diagnosis, so the match rests on the error text alone.

related_issues.reason: Bitdefender flags uv itself as malware. Different symptom (false positive on the installer, not PE-write locking during venv creation), but the same vendor and the same class of AV interference.
Antivirus blocks the uv installer script on Windows. Different symptom and different AV interaction; useful context that AV interference with uv on Windows is a recurring pattern.
Bitdefender blocks the uv installer script. Different symptom; context only.

rationale: The reporter labels this a bug, and I keep that type: uv venv is plainly meant to succeed, and a transient failure with no retry is a robustness gap. The root cause is Bitdefender Incident Sensor interfering with the freshly written trampoline exe. The repro is intermittent and disabling the AV resolves it, so the defect is external (likely_external true). A uv-side bounded retry on transient Windows file errors is a reasonable mitigation the maintainers could consider, but the underlying fault is in the AV product. The report has a repro script, exact error, version and OS, so needs_mre is false. Search found #19873 with the same error text (closed as duplicate of an unidentified canonical), and found no other exact match for the AV-plus-PE-write cause. The related-issue search for Bitdefender turned up only installer false positives. Two calls returned the same results, so the search is stable, though it is a limited sample.
